messages:
jo: Quick sync — were doing a long-tail sampling + benchmark handoff for the new quant pipeline. need a curated eval set that emphasizes multi-turn failures and rare intents.
maya: Agree. Instead of a pure sparsify, can we do a stratified long-tail sampler that oversamples rare intents and multi-turn >4 examples? want to stress KV-cache and rolloff.
linh: Proposed heuristic: bucket by (intent, turns_bin, length_bucket, anchor_hash) then sample with weight = max(1, 10 / sqrt(freq)). cap each bucket to 200. include an untouched 2k golden_regress set.
alex: Good. Also add an "eval-bias" slice: examples where current model has hallucination or factual errors in last 3 runs. We should surface those in the summary.
jo: I'll push sampling tool update. CLI: ```python tools/longtail_sampler.py --input s3://redwood/promptbank/v1.4/ --buckets intent,turns_bin,length_bucket,anchor --weighting sqrt_inv --cap 200 --golden 2000 --out s3://redwood/curation/longtail/```
maya: Can the tool emit per-slice metrics: recall_est, avg_turns, %multiop, and a small sample of dropped items for QA? Product needs that.
linh: yes, adding `--metrics-csv` and `--dropped-sample N`. We'll run a 1% smoke sample first.
ops-bot: Created ticket INF-2401: "longtail sampling + benchmark eval set for quant pipeline" assigned to @linh @jo. https://redwood.internal/infra/tickets/INF-2401
alex: Labeling plan for golden_regress: 1) broad pass OK/FAIL by labelers, 2) targeted expert pass for hallucinations. estimate ~2 FTE-weeks.
jo: timeline: Mon run smoke, Mon afternoon review metrics, Tue label golden, Wed run quant bench. everyone ack?
maya: ack. will review metrics and watch for any slice with recall_est < 0.75.
linh: ack. starting small smoke run now and will post the summary link in INF-2401.
jo: thanks team — ping in the ticket for blockers. :thumbsup:
